text:
SUN’IY INTELLEKT: ETIK ME’YORLAR VA HUQUQIY ASOSLAR
Qarshi shahar 1-son ixtisoslashtirilgan maktab-internatida pedagoglarning kasbiy bilim va ko‘nikmalarini mustahkamlash hamda ta’lim jarayoniga zamonaviy yondashuvlarni joriy etish maqsadida navbatdagi "Kasbiy rivojlanish soati" doirasida seminar-trening tashkil etildi.
Seminar-trening "Pedagogik faoliyatda sun’iy intellektdan foydalanishning etik va huquqiy asoslari" mavzusiga bag‘ishlandi.

text_en:
ARTIFICIAL INTELLIGENCE: ETHICAL STANDARDS AND LEGAL FRAMEWORK
As part of the regular "Professional Development Hour", Karshi City Specialized Boarding School No. 1 held a training seminar to strengthen teachers' professional skills and bring modern approaches into teaching.
The seminar was devoted to "The ethical and legal foundations of using artificial intelligence in teaching".

Akademik bilan uchrashuv
Maktab-internat o‘quvchilari va o‘qituvchilari ishtirokida akademik, O‘zbekiston Respublikasida xizmat ko‘rsatgan fan arbobi, iqtisod fanlari doktori Saidaxror Gulyamov bilan mazmunli uchrashuv bo‘lib o‘tdi. Uchrashuv "Raqamli iqtisodiyotning dolzarb muammolari va zamonaviy yutuqlari" mavzusiga bag‘ishlandi.

text_en:
Meeting with an academician
Students and teachers of the boarding school met with academician Saidakhror Gulyamov, Honored Scientist of the Republic of Uzbekistan and Doctor of Economics. The meeting was devoted to "Current problems and modern achievements of the digital economy".

text:
Sport musobaqasi boshlandi
O‘quvchi-yoshlarning bo‘sh vaqtini mazmunli tashkil etish, ularni sportga keng jalb etish maqsadida 9-, 10- va 11-sinf o‘quvchilari o‘rtasida sport musobaqasi tashkil etildi. Bugun musobaqaning 1-kun saralash bahslari bo‘lib o‘tdi.

text_en:
Sports competition begins
To help students spend their free time meaningfully and get more involved in sports, a sports competition was organized among students of grades 9, 10 and 11. Today the qualifying matches of day 1 took place.
